name: ZesDrift Email & Marketing
author: ZesDrift.com

sections.description:
ZesDrift Email & Marketing is the all-in-one growth suite for WordPress and WooCommerce. By connecting your WordPress site to ZesDrift, you can instantly replace unreliable default PHP emails with our high-deliverability SMTP Engine, and unlock a suite of powerful marketing tools.

Key Features:

  • Reliable SMTP Delivery: Automatically route all WordPress and WooCommerce transactional emails through ZesDrift’s secure API.
  • Form Integrations: Seamlessly capture leads from Contact Form 7, WPForms, Elementor Forms, and Gravity Forms directly into your ZesDrift CRM.
  • WooCommerce Cart Tracking: Automatically track when users begin a checkout and trigger abandoned cart recovery campaigns.
  • Live Chat & AI Chatbots: Inject the ZesDrift Live Chat widget to talk to your website visitors in real-time.
  • Popup Builder: Launch high-converting popups and capture more leads.
  • Visual Email Customizer: Replace boring default WooCommerce emails with beautiful, branded templates designed in our Drag & Drop builder.
  • Background Auto-Sync: Keep your WordPress user base and ZesDrift contact lists perfectly in sync (Hourly or Daily).

Whether you are on our Free plan or a dedicated Enterprise tier, this plugin connects your website to your ZesDrift workspace with just one click.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/zesdrift-woo directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the new ZesDrift menu in your WordPress admin sidebar.
  4. Enter your ZesDrift account credentials to securely connect your workspace.
sections.faq:
Do I need a ZesDrift account to use this plugin?

Yes. You can sign up for a free account at ZesDrift.com.

Does this work with WooCommerce?

Absolutely. The plugin automatically detects WooCommerce and begins tracking checkout behavior for abandoned cart recovery, while also taking over WooCommerce transactional email delivery.

Which form plugins are supported?

We currently offer automatic, zero-setup sync for Contact Form 7, WPForms, Elementor Pro Forms, and Gravity Forms.
